Branch Manager
description:
**Job Purpose**

To lead branch setup and operational readiness, drive business growth in gold lending, build and manage a high-performing branch team, and ensure strict compliance with internal audit standards and regulatory (RBI) guidelines.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Branch Recruitment & Team Building:**
* Source, interview, and hire local talent for key branch roles, including Gold Valuers/Appraisers, Customer Service Officers, Relationship Managers, and Security Personnel.
* Coordinate with HR to manage local hiring pipelines, campus/walk-in drives, and employee onboarding.
* Plan branch staffing levels based on business volume and operational requirements.
* Oversee initial product, compliance, and gold-appraisal training for newly onboarded staff.
* **Business Development & Sales:**
* Drive branch sales targets for gold loan disbursements, cross-selling products, and new customer acquisition.
* Execute local marketing activities and maintain relationships with local business communities to generate leads.
* Oversee loan renewal mix and repeat customer retention strategies.
* **Gold Operations & Risk Management:**
* Ensure accurate gold testing, weighing, and purity assessment following standard appraisal protocols.
* Strictly adhere to Loan-to-Value (LTV) limits and regulatory guidelines.
* Supervise safe vault management, dual-custody procedures, and daily packet verification to protect pledged gold assets.
* **Operations & Compliance:**
* Oversee daily branch transactions, cash management, and operational workflows.
* Maintain compliance with company policies, RBI guidelines, and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) norms.
* Ensure smooth internal and external audit processes and resolve audit queries promptly.
* **Portfolio & Recovery Management:**
* Track overdue loans and lead recovery efforts for early-stage delinquent accounts (0–30 days past due).
* Coordinate loan closure, redemption processes, and statutory auctions for non-performing accounts per legal guidelines.
* **Team Leadership & Customer Service:**
* Manage, mentor, and retain branch staff, providing regular performance evaluations and coaching.
* Resolve escalated customer grievances and ensure high-quality service delivery.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Hiring & Retention:** Time-to-fill for open branch positions, staff onboarding timeline, and branch attrition rate.
* **Growth:** Total Assets Under Management (AUM) and monthly disbursement volume.
* **Risk & Portfolio:** Non-Performing Assets (NPA) percentage and audit compliance score.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* **Education:** Graduate/Postgraduate degree in Business, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.
* **Experience:** 3–8 years in banking/NBFC operations, with proven experience in branch management, team hiring, and gold loan processing.
* **Technical Skills:** Interviewing techniques, knowledge of gold appraisal methods, basic accounting, and branch management software.
* **Soft Skills:** Talent acquisition, team leadership, conflict resolution, sales strategy, and local language proficiency.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person

title: Center Manager
description:
**Job Description – Community Executive**

**Company: GoSpaze**

GoSpaze is a real estate services platform built on professionalism, transparency, and trust. Founded in 2017, GoSpaze began with property marketing services and later expanded into co-working spaces and property management. Today, the company supports the complete real estate journey—from search and discovery to rentals, property management, sales, resale, and co-working solutions. **GoSpaze currently operates 10 co-working centres**, offering flexible and professional workspace solutions to individuals, startups, and enterprises.

**Job Summary**

The Community Executive is responsible for the smooth day-to-day functioning of the GoSpaze co-working centre. The role includes facility operations, housekeeping supervision, vendor coordination, inventory control, and handling walk-in clients and member interactions. The executive ensures a clean, safe, and welcoming environment while supporting client enquiries and converting walk-ins into potential leads through coordination with the sales team.

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**Centre & Facility Management**

* Manage daily operations of the co-working centre to ensure uninterrupted services.
* Ensure the centre is clean, safe, and well-maintained at all times.
* Conduct regular inspections of common areas, workstations, meeting rooms, washrooms, and pantry.
* Coordinate minor maintenance and report major issues to the operations team.

**Housekeeping Management**

* Supervise housekeeping staff and ensure cleaning schedules are followed.
* Maintain hygiene and cleanliness standards across the centre.
* Monitor washrooms, pantry, and common areas regularly.

**Vendor Management**

* Coordinate with vendors for housekeeping, security, maintenance, internet, pantry, and other facility services.
* Track vendor performance and ensure timely service delivery.
* Raise service requests and follow up until closure.

**Inventory & Stock Management**

* Maintain inventory of office supplies, pantry items, housekeeping materials, and consumables.
* Monitor stock levels and initiate purchase requests when required.
* Maintain accurate stock records and support cost control.

**Client & Walk-in Management**

* Greet and assist walk-in clients visiting the co-working centre.
* Provide basic information about GoSpaze services, pricing, and facilities.
* Coordinate with the Sales team for walk-in leads, site visits, and follow-ups.
* Ensure walk-in client details are captured accurately and shared with the relevant team.
* Handle client and member queries professionally and ensure timely resolution.

**Member Support & Coordination**

* Act as the first point of contact for existing members regarding facility-related concerns.
* Resolve member complaints related to infrastructure, housekeeping, or services with urgency.
* Ensure a positive client and member experience at all times.

**Reporting & Compliance**

* Maintain daily operational checklists, walk-in registers, and reports.
* Ensure compliance with safety, security, and facility guidelines.
* Support audits and internal reviews as required.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Graduate or Diploma holder from any discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in co-working, facilities management, hospitality, or customer-facing roles.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel and Microsoft Office tools.
* Well-groomed individual with good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in English; knowledge of local languages is an advantage.
* Strong coordination and vendor management skills.
* Customer-focused mindset with problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to multitask and work under pressure.
* Willingness to work flexible shifts and extended hours when required.Top of FormBottom of Form

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹27,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Guest Relation Executive
description:
**Job Summary**  
We are seeking a polished, articulate, and customer-centric **Guest Relations Executive** to manage the first impression and overall visitor experience at our premium real estate sales office and experience centre. As the primary point of contact, you will bridge the gap between incoming clients and our internal Sales and CRM teams.  
The ideal candidate will combine **luxury hospitality standards** with sharp administrative skills to ensure every prospective buyer, channel partner, and high-net-worth individual (HWI) receives a frictionless, premium experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Front Desk & Guest Experience Management**

* **First Impression:** Greet walk-in customers, channel partners, and VIP guests with a warm, professional, and confident demeanor.
* **Lounge Management:** Maintain the presentation, hygiene, and ambience of the reception, waiting lounges, and AV experience rooms.
* **Hospitality Coordination:** Oversee the serving of refreshments and manage pantry staff to match 5-star hospitality standards.

**2. Customer & Site Visit Coordination**

* **Guided Support:** Assist visitors with registration forms and preliminary documentation, providing high-level information about the project layout.
* **Sales Alignment:** Seamlessly tag and route walk-in clients to available Sales Executives using internal rosters.
* **Calendar Management:** Coordinate schedules for site visits, virtual presentations, and alignment meetings between clients and management.

**3. Data Management & CRM Logging**

* **Lead Tracking:** Diligently capture visitor details and source tracking information into the company’s CRM / ERP system.
* **Feedback Collection:** Hand out feedback/comment cards to prospects post-tour and maintain accurate digital logs for analysis.
* **Documentation Support:** Maintain physical and digital customer file setups before handing them off to the CRM documentation wing.

description:
Business Development Manager (BDM)

Company: TradeGeniuz Capital Private LimitedLocation: Chennai, Tamil NaduJob Type: Full-Time / PermanentDepartment: Business Development, Sales & Growth

About the Role

TradeGeniuz Capital Private Limited is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Business Development Manager (BDM) to drive the company’s overall business growth.

The BDM will be responsible for direct sales, Sales Team Management, B2B & B2C Business Development, Digital Marketing Team Management, Business Strategy and Revenue Growth.

This is a hands-on leadership position. The candidate should be capable of developing business strategies as well as directly participating in sales, client meetings, negotiations and deal closures.

Key Responsibilities

Direct Sales & Sales Management

* Personally handle high-potential leads and key customers
* Conduct client calls, meetings and sales presentations
* Understand customer requirements and convert opportunities into sales
* Negotiate and close deals
* Handle key accounts and important client relationships
* Lead and manage the Sales Team
* Set daily, weekly and monthly sales targets
* Monitor individual and overall team performance
* Improve lead follow-up, conversion and closing processes
* Train, guide and motivate sales executives
* Develop sales scripts, processes and closing strategies
* Take ownership of achieving monthly revenue targets

B2B & B2C Business Development

* Identify new B2B and B2C business opportunities
* Build corporate and strategic partnerships
* Develop new customer acquisition channels
* Approach potential partners and business clients
* Prepare business proposals and presentations
* Negotiate partnership and commercial terms
* Identify new markets and expansion opportunities
* Build long-term relationships with customers and partners

Digital Marketing Team Management

* Lead and coordinate the Digital Marketing team
* Align marketing campaigns with sales and revenue objectives
* Plan lead-generation and customer-acquisition strategies
* Monitor lead quality and marketing performance
* Review CPL, CAC, Conversion Rate, ROI and other important KPIs
* Coordinate Performance Marketing, Social Media and Content activities
* Ensure marketing campaigns generate quality leads and measurable business results
* Improve marketing strategies based on actual sales and conversion data

Business Strategy & Growth

* Develop monthly, quarterly and annual business growth strategies
* Create sales and revenue growth plans
* Conduct market and competitor analysis
* Identify new products, services, partnerships and revenue opportunities
* Develop and execute go-to-market strategies
* Analyse business performance and identify areas for improvement
* Set KPIs for Sales and Marketing teams
* Prepare business performance reports for Management
* Work directly with the Founder & Management on company growth and expansion

Candidate Requirements

* 0 –2+ years of experience in Business Development and Sales
* Strong direct sales and deal-closing experience
* Proven experience managing a Sales Team
* Experience in both B2B and B2C business development
* Ability to manage and coordinate a Digital Marketing Team
* Strong understanding of Lead Generation, Sales Funnels and Customer Acquisition
* Strong negotiation and communication skills
* Business strategy and analytical thinking ability
* Leadership and team-management skills
* Target and revenue-oriented mindset
* Tamil & English communication required
* MBA / Business / Marketing background will be an added advantage

What We Expect

The BDM should be capable of handling the complete growth cycle:

Business Strategy → Marketing → Lead Generation → Sales → Deal Closing → Team Management → Revenue Growth

We are looking for a hands-on Business Development Manager, not someone who only manages reports or gives instructions.

The candidate should be willing to personally participate in sales and closing while simultaneously leading the Sales and Digital Marketing teams.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary based on experience
* Performance-based incentives
* Direct opportunity to work with the Founder & Management
* Leadership responsibility for Sales & Business Growth
* Opportunity to develop and execute new business strategies
* Long-term career growth based on performance

Candidates with strong Sales + Business Development + Team Management experience are encouraged to apply.

title: Assistant Manager - Referral & Alternative Sourcing
description:
1. Role Objective

To drive business sourcing, qualified lead generation, site visits, and bookings through Customer Referrals, Loyalty Programs, Employee Referrals, Corporate Associations, Outstation and NRI initiatives, and other alternative sourcing channels. The role is responsible for developing sustainable sourcing programs, achieving assigned business targets, improving conversion efficiency, and ensuring cost-effective execution in alignment with the organization's business plan.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Business Planning & Sourcing Strategy

1. Develop and implement sourcing plans for new project launches and sustenance business through Referral, Loyalty, Employee, Corporate, Outstation, NRI, and Alternative Sourcing channels.

2. Plan and achieve a minimum of 50% of the overall business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels, with the balance 50% attributed to marketing-led sourcing, as per the approved business plan.

3. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head to establish monthly, quarterly, and annual sourcing targets for each channel.

4. Develop long-term sourcing strategies and scalable programs to ensure consistent business contribution across projects.

5. Identify new sourcing opportunities, assess their potential, and recommend initiatives to strengthen lead generation and business conversion.

B. Referral & Loyalty Program Management

1. Develop and execute customer referral and loyalty programs to generate qualified leads, site visits, and bookings.

2. Design structured referral initiatives to encourage existing customers to recommend the organization's projects to prospective buyers.

3. Coordinate with the Brand & Marketing Head to develop referral benefits, customer engagement initiatives, and loyalty program structures.

4. Monitor referral lead quality, customer engagement, conversion rates, and program effectiveness.

5. Identify opportunities to increase repeat business, customer advocacy, and referrals across existing projects.

C. Employee & Corporate Sourcing

1. Develop and implement employee referral programs to generate qualified prospects through the organization's internal network.

2. Establish and strengthen corporate sourcing initiatives through associations with IT companies, manufacturing companies, institutions, and other relevant organizations.

3. Plan and execute corporate engagement activities, employee outreach programs, and targeted property awareness initiatives.

4. Work with internal stakeholders to communicate project offerings and approved employee or corporate benefits.

5. Track lead generation, site visits, bookings, and business contribution from employee and corporate sourcing initiatives.

D. Outstation, NRI & Alternative Sourcing

1. Develop targeted sourcing strategies to generate business from outstation customers, NRIs, and other relevant customer segments.

2. Identify suitable markets, customer groups, and engagement opportunities to expand the organization's sourcing footprint.

3. Coordinate with the Marketing and Sales Teams to execute targeted outreach programs, customer engagement initiatives, and project presentation activities.

4. Develop alternative sourcing initiatives based on market opportunities and business requirements.

5. Monitor channel-wise performance and optimize sourcing strategies based on lead quality, site visits, bookings, and acquisition costs.

E. Site Visit Generation & Conversion Management

1. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Sales Team, and Telemarketing Team to convert sourced leads into qualified site visits and bookings.

2. Maintain a minimum 10% lead-to-walk-in ratio and 15% walk-in-to-booking ratio, as per organizational benchmarks.

3. Achieve an average booking conversion of 15% against the applicable assigned sourcing base, as defined in the approved business plan.

4. Track lead movement, follow-ups, site visit scheduling, actual walk-ins, bookings, and cancellations across all sourcing channels.

5. Identify conversion gaps and implement corrective action plans in coordination with the relevant teams.

6. Take proactive measures to minimize avoidable cancellations through timely follow-ups and customer coordination.

F. Budget & Cost Management

1. Ensure that referral benefits, loyalty incentives, employee and corporate benefits, activation expenses, and other sourcing-related costs remain within approved budgets.

2. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams to plan and monitor sourcing expenditure.

3. Track cost per lead, cost per site visit, cost per booking, and return on investment for each sourcing initiative.

4. Recommend measures to improve sourcing efficiency and maximize business contribution within approved cost parameters.

5. Ensure all benefits, incentives, and commercial commitments follow the organization's approval processes.

G. Payout Management & Operational Coordination

1. Coordinate with Finance and relevant internal teams to ensure accurate processing and timely settlement of approved referral benefits, loyalty rewards, and other eligible sourcing-related payouts.

2. Maintain proper documentation of referrals, lead registrations, eligibility, approvals, booking references, and payout status.

3. Resolve payout-related queries and discrepancies in coordination with the concerned teams.

4. Ensure compliance with approved payout policies, documentation requirements, and internal processes.

H. CRM, MIS & Performance Monitoring

1. Ensure disciplined usage of SFDC (Salesforce) for lead registration, source attribution, lead tracking, and booking updates.

2. Ensure accurate and timely recording of all sourcing activities and maintain reliable channel-wise data.

3. Prepare regular MIS reports covering lead generation, sourcing contribution, site visits, booking conversions, cancellations, expenditure, and program performance.

4. Review performance against monthly and quarterly targets and implement corrective measures wherever required.

5. Use data-driven insights to identify high-performing sourcing initiatives and improve overall business productivity.

I. Governance, Ethics & Compliance

1. Maintain high standards of ethics, integrity, transparency, and professional conduct across all sourcing activities.

2. Ensure adherence to organizational policies, approved benefits, documentation standards, and applicable compliance requirements.

3. Prevent unauthorized commitments, incorrect source attribution, payout irregularities, and conflicts of interest.

4. Maintain effective coordination with Marketing, Sales, Telemarketing, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Sourcing Contribution: Minimum 50% of the approved business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels.

- Lead-to-Walk-in Ratio: Minimum 10%.

- Walk-in-to-Booking Ratio: Minimum 15%.

- Booking Conversion: Average 15% against the defined sourcing base.

- Referral & Loyalty Programs: Achievement of assigned lead, walk-in, and booking targets.

- Employee & Corporate Sourcing: Achievement of approved sourcing targets.

- Outstation & NRI Sourcing: Achievement of assigned business contribution targets.

- Cost Efficiency: Sourcing expenditure maintained within approved budgets.

- Cancellation Management: Reduction in avoidable booking cancellations.

- CRM Compliance: Accurate and timely SFDC usage and source attribution.

- Payout Efficiency: Timely processing of eligible benefits and rewards.

- Reporting & Governance: Timely MIS submission and adherence to organizational policies.

4. Key Working Relationships

- Brand & Marketing Head

- Sales Team

- Telemarketing Team

- Finance Team

- Vendor Management Team

- Strategy and Business Planning Team

- Existing Customers and Referral Networks

- Corporate Organizations and Employee Networks

5. Role Expectations

The Assistant Manager is expected to demonstrate strong business ownership, relationship management, analytical capability, planning, and execution discipline. The role requires proactive identification of sourcing opportunities, close coordination with internal stakeholders, and regular engagement at project sites, including weekends when required.

Success in this role will be measured by sustainable alternative sourcing growth, achievement of assigned business targets, improved lead-to-site-visit and booking conversions, and cost-effective execution within approved budgets.

title: Admission Counsellor
description:
About the Job: 
 Institution: Jain School of Future Technology (JSOFT)
 Location: Kochi, Kerala (On-site) Experience Required: 0-3 Years (Experience in Admissions, Counselling, Sales)
 Employment Type: Full-time 
 Company Description: JAIN School of Future Technology (JSOFT) is a mission-driven institution focused on breaking traditional barriers in education and employment in India. The school offers work-integrated programs, enabling students to learn directly from industry experts, tackle real-world challenges, and gain professional experience while earning their degree. Its flagship Work-Integrated BCA Programme combines strong academic foundations with immediate workplace exposure in dynamic professional settings. The school is committed to building skills, enhancing adaptability, and creating opportunities that help learners overcome socio-economic limitations. JAIN School of Future Technology is dedicated to shaping futures and redefining education through practical, career-focused learning. 
 Role Description: The Admission Counsellor plays a vital role in guiding prospective students through their academic journey by providing comprehensive information about JSOFT's programs, admission process, and career opportunities. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Kochi. The Admission Counsellor will be responsible for handling student enquiries through calls, emails, WhatsApp, and walk-ins, understanding students' educational aspirations, and counselling them on suitable programs. The role involves following up with prospective students, nurturing leads, and converting enquiries into successful admissions. The Admission Counsellor will also maintain accurate records in the CRM, coordinate with internal departments to ensure a seamless admission process, and contribute towards achieving monthly admission targets while delivering an exceptional student experience. 
 Qualifications: Candidates should possess excellent communication, interpersonal, and counselling skills to effectively engage with prospective students and parents. Candidates should have strong sales, negotiation, and relationship-building abilities with a passion for helping students make informed career decisions. Candidates should possess experience in Admission Counselling, Academic Counselling, Business Development, Customer Relationship Management, Telecalling, or Educational Sales. Experience in the education sector will be an added advantage. Candidates should be proficient in handling inbound and outbound calls, lead follow-ups, and CRM software. Bachelor's degree in any discipline is required. A Master's degree is an added advantage. Freshers with exceptional communication skills and a strong interest in educational counselling are encouraged to apply. Proficiency in English is mandatory. Knowledge of Malayalam and Hindi will be an added advantage. Candidates should possess strong organizational skills, target orientation, and the ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining high levels of professionalism. 
 Key Responsibilities: Counsel prospective students and parents regarding academic programs, career opportunities, eligibility criteria, fee structure, and admission procedures. Handle enquiries received through phone calls, emails, website, WhatsApp, and walk-in visits. Conduct regular follow-ups with prospective students to maximize admission conversions. Build and maintain positive relationships with students throughout the admission cycle. Maintain accurate student information and interaction records in the CRM system. Coordinate with academic and administrative teams to ensure a smooth admission and onboarding process. Participate in education fairs, seminars, webinars, career guidance sessions, and promotional activities organized by the institution. Consistently achieve monthly admission targets while ensuring a high standard of student satisfaction. Student Counselling To Apply: Send your updated resume and a short cover letter highlighting your experience in admissions, student counselling, educational sales, or customer relationship management to HR@acced.in with the subject line: "Application: Admission Counsellor JSOFT Kochi"

Senior Analyst - Procurement Research
description:
Do you have a strong understanding of end\-to\-end procurement processes and how emerging technologies are transforming these processes? Are you experienced in primary and secondary research methods? We are seeking an individual to play a pivotal role in our procurement practice, supporting the development of thought leadership and the creation of research content.
 



 At The Hackett Group®, we offer opportunities to learn, connect, and collaborate with professionals worldwide, helping them achieve new performance and competitive advantages. As a procurement research professional, you will partner with Hackett’s procurement advisors, clients, and global stakeholders across industries to understand key trends, issues, and challenges related to establishing world\-class performance. You will be a member of The Hackett Group’s research team, which covers G\&A functions (finance, HR, AI, and procurement), GBS, payroll, and other end\-to\-end process programs. You will work closely with advisors in the Applied Intelligence practice and colleagues across the research organization.
 



**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking an experienced procurement research professional to play a pivotal role in the development of high‑impact thought leadership, benchmarking insights, and client‑facing research deliverables. This role sits within The Hackett Group’s global research team and works in close partnership with senior procurement advisors and practice leaders.
 



 Success in this role requires exceptional PowerPoint capability, strong analytical skills, and proven research experience. Candidates must be able to operate independently, move quickly, and translate research insights into clear, compelling, executive‑ready deliverables with minimal guidance.
 



**Critical Success Factors for This Role** 




**PowerPoint Mastery – Mandatory** 




 PowerPoint is not a supporting skill in this role; it is
 *core* 
 . The successful candidate must:
 


* Walk in the door with advanced PowerPoint skills, including slide storytelling, visual structuring of complex ideas, charting, tables, and executive‑level layouts
* Work quickly and confidently in creating and refining slides for senior audiences
* Be capable of producing polished, client‑ready decks (e.g., Spotlight reports, benchmark readouts, research summaries) with limited iteration



**Excel \& Analytical Skills – Strongly Preferred** 



* Highly proficient user of Generative AI models (inc. Co\-Pilot) and a proven ability to interrogate and validate the model outputs.
* Solid Excel skills are required for analyzing benchmark data, survey results, and research inputs
* Ability to move from raw data to insights efficiently



**Prior Research Experience** 




 This role requires proven procurement research experience. The candidate must have:
 


* Hands‑on experience with primary and secondary research in a professional setting
* Prior responsibility for shaping research questions, analyzing findings, synthesizing insights, and developing structured research outputs
* Demonstrated ability to work independently in a fast\-paced, deadline driven environment



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop fresh perspectives on procurement business and technology trends, including emerging areas such as generative AI and agentic AI
* Lead and support the creation of procurement research deliverables, including:
* Benchmark‑driven and Spotlight reports
* Quantitative and qualitative research outputs
* Client\-specific insights and customized deliverables
* Executive presentations and and thought leadership content
* Training, enablement, and knowledge\-sharing materials
* Shape, execute, and synthesize findings from quantitative and qualitative research initiatives
* Translate research outputs into high‑quality PowerPoint deliverables for internal and external use
* Edit, critique, and refine research outputs to meet Hackett quality, storytelling and presentation standards
* Collaborate closely with procurement advisors to ensure research remains relevant, actionable, and client‑ready
* Track procurement and technology trends via market analysis, vendor activity, news, and investment signals
* Ensure turnaround\-time (TAT) targets for all deliverables/requests are consistently met



**Ways of Working / Operating Model** 



* This role works primarily with senior procurement leaders as internal customers who will

description:

To manage and coordinate the day-to-day operations of the Operation Theatre, ensuring efficient utilization of OT resources, patient safety, infection control, staff coordination, and adherence to hospital policies and clinical standards. 
 Key Responsibilities Manage the day-to-day functioning and smooth operations of all Operation Theatres. Coordinate and schedule elective and emergency surgeries in consultation with surgeons, anaesthesia teams, and concerned departments. Ensure OT readiness before every procedure, including instruments, equipment, consumables, implants, and required medications. Supervise and allocate duties to OT nurses, technicians, attendants, and support staff. Ensure compliance with infection prevention and control practices, sterilization protocols, and OT safety standards. Coordinate with CSSD for timely availability of sterile instruments and surgical sets. Ensure proper maintenance, cleaning, disinfection, and environmental standards of the OT complex. Monitor availability and utilization of OT equipment, instruments, consumables, and emergency supplies. Ensure proper documentation of surgeries, OT registers, checklists, implant records, and other required records. Ensure strict compliance with surgical safety protocols, including patient identification, site marking, surgical safety checklist, and count procedures. Coordinate with Biomedical Engineering, Pharmacy, Stores, Housekeeping, Maintenance, and other support departments for uninterrupted OT services. Monitor OT utilization, cancellations, delays, turnaround time, and other operational parameters. Identify operational issues and take timely corrective action in coordination with the concerned departments. Ensure proper handling, segregation, and disposal of biomedical waste as per hospital policy. Conduct regular audits and ensure compliance with NABH and other applicable accreditation standards. Participate in incident reporting, root-cause analysis, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Train, guide, and mentor OT staff on clinical procedures, safety practices, infection control, and hospital protocols. Prepare duty rosters and ensure adequate staffing based on OT workload. Maintain discipline and professional standards among OT staff. Coordinate emergency OT requirements and ensure availability of necessary manpower and resources. Monitor staff performance and provide feedback to the concerned reporting authority. Prepare and submit OT-related MIS reports and operational data as required. Perform any other duties assigned by the management. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) OT utilization and productivity Reduction in OT delays and cancellations OT turnaround time Compliance with surgical safety checklist Infection control and sterilization compliance Availability of instruments, equipment, and consumables Documentation and audit compliance Staff productivity and attendance Patient safety and incident management Compliance with NABH/hospital policies Qualification B.Sc. Nursing / Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing / GNM. Diploma or certification in Operation Theatre Technology/Management may be considered based on experience. Experience 510 years of relevant hospital experience, preferably with experience in Operation Theatre management. Prior experience in a supervisory or OT In-Charge role will be preferred. Skills & Competencies Strong OT operations and coordination skills Knowledge of surgical procedures and OT protocols Good understanding of infection prevention and control Knowledge of sterilization and CSSD processes Strong team management and leadership skill

Key Skills: OT,Operation Theatre,Operations,Theatre
venue: Sector 28, Chakkarpur, Gurugram, Haryana 122009

 JOB DESCRIPTION FOR 2A: 
 Role Summary: Own end-to-end merchant dispute handling across Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Discover, including chargeback, representment, pre-arbitration, and arbitration. Maximize recovery, ensure rule compliance, and deliver a strong merchant experience under network SLAs. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 A. Dispute & Chargeback Lifecycle: Triage disputes (including retrievals/RFIs), validate reason codes, and decide action (accept/represent/pre-arb/arb). Prepare and file Compelling Evidence (CE) for representments within network/processor SLAs. Lead pre-arbitration negotiations; prepare arbitration submissions with accurate documentation and clear arguments. Track outcomes, escalate edge cases, reduce cycle times, and improve win/recovery rates. 
 B. Evidence & Documentation: Collect and package CE: transaction logs, AVS/CVV/3DS data, device/IP signals, delivery proof, customer communications, screenshots, T&Cs/cancellation policies, refund records, support transcripts. Maintain reason-code libraries and SOPs aligned to Visa Claims Resolution (VCR) and Mastercard Dispute Resolution (MDR); ensure documentation is audit-ready. 
 C. Merchant & Stakeholder Communication: Liaise with merchants, Customer Support, Risk, Finance, acquirers/processors, and external partners to gather data and resolve disputes promptly. Educate merchants on prevention (billing descriptors/testing, receipt design, refund policies, shipping/signature confirmation, post-purchase communications). 
 D. Compliance & Controls: Adhere to Visa/Mastercard/Amex/Discover rules and acquirer/processor guidelines; ensure evidence integrity and privacy compliance. Support monitoring programs (e.g., Visa VDMP/VFMP; Mastercard ECP) by supplying accurate dispute/fraud metrics. 
 E. Reporting & Continuous Improvement: Track KPIs: representment win rate, recovery dollars, TAT/cycle time, pre-arb avoidance, write-off reduction, dispute ratio health. Identify root causes and drive prevention playbooks (descriptor hygiene, friendly-fraud defenses, SCA/3DS optimization, logistics/signature policies). Contribute to automation/templates and quality reviews to enable First-Time-Right submissions. 
 Required Qualifications: 1 to 2 years in merchant disputes & chargebacks across Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover. Practical exposure to VCR/MDR workflows and phases (chargeback representment pre-arb arbitration). Experience drafting reason-code-specific narratives and assembling CE. Hands-on with VROL, Mastercom/Claims Manager, Amex/Discover portals; CRM/ticketing tools. Strong analytical and written skills; ability to interpret payment data/logs to build a defensible case. High ownership, urgency, and resilience under tight deadlines; willingness to work US hours onsite (no hybrid/remote). 
 Preferred Qualifications: Experience with acquirers/PSPs (e.g., Fiserv/First Data, Worldpay/FIS, TSYS, Adyen, Stripe) and tools like Ethoca/Verifi Order Insight. Knowledge of chargeback prevention best practices. Intermediate Excel/Sheets; basic SQL/BI a plus. Exposure to merchant education/training on prevention. Bachelors degree in Business/Finance/Accounting/Commerce. 
 JOB DESCRIPTION FOR 3A: 
 Role Summary: Serve as the domain expert for multi-brand dispute managementelevating win rates through evidence strategy, rule interpretation (VCR/MDR/Amex/Discover), and advanced escalationswhile coaching the floor and owning complex/high-value cases. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 A. Complex Case Leadership: Own high-value/complex disputes end-to-end; optimize representment narratives and CE per reason code. Lead pre-arbitration strategies and arbitration submissions with precise arguments and artefacts. 
 B. Rule Interpretation & Governance: Interpret network rule changes; update SOPs/playbooks and roll out training/calibrations. Partner with acquirers/processors on policy clarifications and case-level negotiations. 
 C. Quality & Enablement: Review/approve critical submissions to ensure First-Time-Right quality; reduce rework/defects. Coach Agents; certify new hires for production; drive template/snippet/evidence-checklist improvements. 
 D. Prevention & Analytics: Identify friendly-fraud patterns and systemic gaps; recommend prevention (descriptor hygiene, refund/return design, SCA/3DS). Collaborate with Analytics/Automation to scale insights and reduce manual workload. 
 Required Qualifications: Deep knowledge of VCR/MDR, Amex & Discover procedures; strong case-law style writing. Hands-on with VROL, Mastercom, Amex/Discover portals; CRM; intermediate Excel; SQL/BI preferred. Proven track record improving win rates and reducing pre-arb volumes.

title: Walk-in || Ai Ml Engineer
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 21 Sep - 27 Sep
Timing: 10.00 AM - 5.30 PM
Venue: Company: IVTEX Corporate Solutions Pvt. Ltd. (ICSPL)
Venue: 2nd Floor, Tower-1 Commercial Complex, NBCC Imperia, 203, MCL Rd, New Government Colony, Mancheswar, Bhubaneswar
Contact: Neetu Singh (9692600127)

Job Description AI/ML Engineer 
 Position: AI/ML Engineer
 Department: Technology / AI & Data Science
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Location: Bhubaneswar, Odisha
 Reporting To: Technical Lead / Project Manager
 Experience: 25 Years
 Qualification: B.Tech/B.E./M.Tech/MCA/M.Sc. in Computer Science, IT, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or related field 
 Role Overview 
 We are looking for a skilled and motivated AI/ML Engineer to design, develop, deploy, and maintain Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions for real-world business applications. The candidate will be responsible for the complete ML lifecycle, including data preparation, model development, evaluation, deployment, API integration, performance monitoring, and optimization. The role may also involve Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), computer vision, NLP, and intelligent automation depending on project requirements. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Design, develop, train, test, and deploy Machine Learning and Deep Learning models. Analyze and preprocess structured and unstructured datasets for model development. Perform data cleaning, feature engineering, feature selection, and exploratory data analysis. Develop predictive models, classification models, recommendation systems, forecasting solutions, and other ML-based applications. Build solutions using Python and ML frameworks such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost , or equivalent technologies. Develop and integrate Generative AI and LLM-based applications , where required. Work with LLM APIs and open-source models for applications such as chatbots, document intelligence, summarization, information extraction, and knowledge assistants. Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, embeddings, vector search, and prompt engineering for GenAI applications. Work on NLP and/or Computer Vision solutions based on project requirements. Develop REST APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI or Flask for AI/ML model integration. Deploy ML models into production environments and integrate them with web/mobile/backend applications. Optimize models for accuracy, latency, scalability, and computational efficiency. Establish model evaluation metrics and conduct validation, testing, and performance benchmarking. Monitor deployed models for performance degradation, data drift, model drift, and other production issues. Maintain proper model versioning, experiment tracking, documentation, and reproducibility. Collaborate with software developers, data engineers, business analysts, QA teams, and project managers. Convert business requirements into technically feasible AI/ML solutions. Research emerging AI/ML technologies and evaluate their applicability to organizational projects. Follow data privacy, information security, and responsible AI practices. 
 Required Technical Skills 
 Programming: 
Python, SQL Machine Learning: 
Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, XGBoost/LightGBM, feature engineering, supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation and optimization Deep Learning: 
PyTorch and/or TensorFlow/Keras, neural networks, CNNs, Transformers Generative AI / LLM: 
LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, vector databases, LLM APIs and/or open-source models NLP: 
Text preprocessing, classification, information extraction, semantic search, transformers Computer Vision Preferred: 
OpenCV, object detection, image classification, OCR and related vision models API Development: 
FastAPI / Flask / REST API integration Databases: 
MySQL/PostgreSQL and exposure to NoSQL databases MLOps / Deployment: 
Docker, Git, CI/CD fundamentals, model versioning, experiment tracking and production model monitoring Cloud Preferred: 
AWS / Microsoft Azure / Google Cloud Platform 
 Preferred Tools & Technologies 
 Exposure to some of the following will be advantageous: Hugging Face Transformers LangChain / LlamaIndex or similar frameworks FAISS / Pinecone / Weaviate / Chroma or other vector databases MLflow / Weights & Biases Jupyter Notebook Git/GitHub/GitLab Docker Kubernetes Apache Airflow OpenCV ONNX Cloud-based AI/ML services 
 Required Knowledge 
 The candidate should have a strong understanding of: Machine Learning algorithms Statistics and probability Linear algebra fundamentals Data preprocessing and feature engineering Model selection and hyperparameter tuning Classification, regression and clustering Deep Learning architectures Transformers and modern AI architectures Model evaluation metrics Data structures and algorithms ML deployment and inference pipelines API-based model integration Data security and privacy principles 
 Key Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving ability Ability to independently troubleshoot technical issues Strong coding and debugging skills Research-oriented approach to emerging AI technologies Ability to understand business problems and translate them into AI solutions Good documentation skills Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration Ability to manage multiple development tasks and project deadlines 
 Preferred Candidate Profile Preference will be given to candidates who have: Developed and deployed at least one production-level AI/ML application. Hands-on experience taking an ML project from data preparation model development deployment monitoring . Experience developing GenAI/LLM applications using RAG or similar architectures. Experience integrating AI models with existing software applications. Experience working with large datasets and production databases. A strong GitHub portfolio or demonstrable AI/ML projects. Experience working on government, enterprise, smart-city, surveillance, analytics, or large-scale technology projects will be an added advantage. 
 Selection Process Candidates may be evaluated through: Resume/Profile Screening Technical Interview Practical AI/ML Assignment or Coding Test Project/Model Demonstration Final Technical/Management Discussion 
 During the technical evaluation, candidates should be prepared to explain one AI/ML project end-to-end , including the business problem, dataset, preprocessing, model selection, evaluation metrics, deployment architecture, challenges faced, and final results. 
 Expected Deliverables 
 The selected AI/ML Engineer will be expected to deliver reliable and production-ready AI solutions, maintain appropriate technical documentation, support deployment and integration, monitor model performance, and continuously improve AI/ML systems based on business and project requirements.
